method.timing: Presentation timestamps independently read with ffprobe; duplicate-run duration uses actual PTS intervals.
method.scaling: Area averaging to8-bit gray, after ROI crop.
method.cumulativeAnchorGuard: Also compare each near-duplicate frame to the fixed start of its run. Reset/break when cumulative change exceeds the same thresholds. This prevents tiny continuous drift from being counted as one literal freeze.
method.limits: Near-duplicate/change rate is a visual-change proxy, not an instrumented game render-fps counter. Camera tracking, deliberate static UI, and settled landing result can legitimately repeat. Container30fps is not evidence of smoothness. Full-game and central-world crops exclude external captions; closeups can move the craft outside the central crop, so both are reported.

segments.name: Powered ascent and actual instruments; no staging claim

nativeSourcePrescan.interpretation: Decoded adjacent and cumulative-anchor visual changes, not a rendering-fps counter. Excludes menu/title/deliberately settled debrief sources.

audio.method: Decode final AAC to48kHz stereo PCM, measure unclipped PCM samples, independently correlate known speech stem to export, then fit known voice/music stems within each spoken beat. Speech-over-residual uses20ms speech-active blocks.
audio.limits: RMS dBFS is reported separately from loudnorm integrated LUFS/true peak. A numeric level test does not replace listening for intelligibility/pronunciation. Timing correlation uses mono-average; stem fits and speech/residual level comparisons preserve both stereo channels.

film.measurement: ffmpeg loudnorm first-pass input statistics; no modification to deliverable

beats.text: This is Kinetic Core, created by Mykyta Borisov.
Compare worlds, choose a destination, and plan your mission.
Select compatible components, adjust their dimensions, and watch mass, thrust, and fuel change together.
These numbers are part of the flight model.
Launch, manage your engine, and follow the instruments as the mission unfolds.
Gravity, propellant flow, and changing mass shape every maneuver.
For the final approach, practice a local Moon landing.
Read altitude, vertical speed, and sideways drift.
Powered guidance helps, but it still uses fuel.
Then switch to a separate docking exercise.
Change camera views, align the spacecraft, and make small corrections with reaction-control thrusters.
Finally, review the touchdown: real contact speeds, remaining fuel, and a clear result.
Built for curious students and future explorers, Kinetic Core turns engineering choices into something you can see, test, and understand.

audio.listeningStatus: Not established by this numeric analysis; direct listening required separately.

visualReview.evidence: Visual checks used final MP4 decoded RGB frames saved through PIL as PNG, including all22caption bands and selected full-frame operations. This avoids the image-viewer JPEG clipping artifact. Motion assessment additionally uses every decoded frame and the transparent adjacent/cumulative-anchor metrics.
visualReview.listeningStatus: This agent did not perform subjective listening. Whole narration presence, exact0.500s offset, last-phrase gain, per-phrase stereo voice/music separation, LUFS/true peak and zero clipping are independently measured. Pronunciation and musical feel require the parent listening review.
visualReview.conclusion: No actionable visual, cadence or encoded-audio alignment defect found. Active flight no longer has the multi-second near-identical holds seen in v1. Intentional menu/inspection/settled-result stillness is classified separately.

conclusion: No actionable visual, cadence or encoded-audio alignment defect found. Active flight no longer has the multi-second near-identical holds seen in v1. Intentional menu/inspection/settled-result stillness is classified separately.
